searchText: People think they can use "L2" to get cheaper fees with Uniswap but thats not how it works 🙂 They need to find a dapp with uniswap or better yet, uniswap becomes its own dapp. Its even being said that ethereum will be "rollup centric" roadmap. Basically rollups will be the dapps and they will support different things. You will come around to my messaging eventually 🙂
